python3 << 'PYEOF'
target = "((..(((((........(.((..((.(.....(....).((((((((.........((......((((.....))))......))...((..((.......(..(......)..)..((..((.....((....)).((((.....(((.....(..((.(...).))..).....))).((((...(.......(..(.((...)).)..).......)...))))........)))).....((((((...)))))).))..))...........))..)).........(..((((....))((((((.....(........).....))))))..))..)...))))))))........).))..)).).....(.......).)))))..))."

# Parse pairs
stack = []
pairs = {}
for i, c in enumerate(target):
    if c == '(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c == ')':
        j = stack.pop()
        pairs[i] = j
        pairs[j] = i

# Build initial sequence
seq = ['A'] * len(target)
for i, j in pairs.items():
    if i < j:  # only assign once per pair
        # Default to stronger pairs especially for lonely pairs
        # Check if this is a lonely pair (not stacked)
        is_lonely = True
        if (i-1 in pairs and j+1 in pairs and pairs[i-1] == j+1):
            is_lonely = False
        if (i+1 in pairs and j-1 in pairs and pairs[i+1] == j-1):
            is_lonely = False
        
        if is_lonely:
            seq[i] = 'G'; seq[j] = 'C'
        else:
            # Alternate GC and AU/GC mix
            h = hash((i,j)) % 100
            if h < 60:
                seq[i] = 'G'; seq[j] = 'C'
            elif h < 85:
                seq[i] = 'C'; seq[j] = 'G'
            else:
                seq[i] = 'A'; seq[j] = 'U'

seq_str = ''.join(seq)

# Now apply hairpin cap recommendations from the analysis
# loop@[33,36] len=4 closing@[32,37] -> C-G closing, GAAA cap
# Apply GAAA at pos 33-36
for idx, ch in enumerate("GAAA"):
    seq[33+idx] = ch
seq[32] = 'C'; seq[37] = 'G'

# loop@[68,72] len=5 closing@[67,73] -> G-C closing, GAAAC cap
for idx, ch in enumerate("GAAAC"):
    seq[68+idx] = ch
seq[67] = 'G'; seq[73] = 'C'

# loop@[105,110] len=6 closing@[104,111] -> G-C closing, GAAAAC cap
for idx, ch in enumerate("GAAAAC"):
    seq[105+idx] = ch
seq[104] = 'G'; seq[111] = 'C'

# loop@[130,133] len=4 closing@[129,134] -> C-G closing, GAAA cap
for idx, ch in enumerate("GAAA"):
    seq[130+idx] = ch
seq[129] = 'C'; seq[134] = 'G'

# loop@[161,163] len=3 closing@[160,164] -> C-G closing, GAA cap (triloop!)
for idx, ch in enumerate("GAA"):
    seq[161+idx] = ch
seq[160] = 'C'; seq[164] = 'G'

# loop@[202,204] len=3 closing@[201,205] -> C-G closing, GAA cap (triloop!)
for idx, ch in enumerate("GAA"):
    seq[202+idx] = ch
seq[201] = 'C'; seq[205] = 'G'

# loop@[250,252] len=3 closing@[249,253] -> C-G closing, GAA cap (triloop!)
for idx, ch in enumerate("GAA"):
    seq[250+idx] = ch
seq[249] = 'C'; seq[253] = 'G'

# loop@[299,302] len=4 closing@[298,303] -> C-G closing, GAAA cap
for idx, ch in enumerate("GAAA"):
    seq[299+idx] = ch
seq[298] = 'C'; seq[303] = 'G'

# loop@[317,324] len=8 closing@[316,325] -> G-C closing, AAAAAAAA
for idx in range(8):
    seq[317+idx] = 'A'
seq[316] = 'G'; seq[325] = 'C'

# loop@[379,385] len=7 closing@[378,386] -> G-C closing, AAAAAAA
for idx in range(7):
    seq[379+idx] = 'A'
seq[378] = 'G'; seq[386] = 'C'

seq_str = ''.join(seq)
print(f"Sequence length: {len(seq_str)}")
print(f"SEQUENCE: {seq_str}")
